verdict.rationale: A startup-focused law firm could plausibly publish public guides, FAQs or explainers, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows practice-area pages describing the services VLP offers (entity formation, financings, equity compensation). None of it shows plain-language educational content, FAQs, or a knowledge base on formation, financing or equity.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages
